title: Design System: Surat Dinas Minahasa Selatan

print-body.purpose: Matches the official physical A4 layout constraints exactly.

print-mono.purpose: Used for strict archival stamps and reference codes within the paper layout.

shadows.name: shadow-md
shadows.purpose: Slight lift for hover states on stat cards.

shadows.name: shadow-glass
shadows.purpose: Reserved for modals, dropdowns, and floating elements.

components.name: Primary Button
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: var(--colors-forest-green, #2A7356); color: #fff; padding: 10px 20px; border-radius: 8px; font-family: 'DM Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; border: none; cursor: pointer; transition: all 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--colors-forest-green-dark, #215D45); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.97); }

components.name: Form Input
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; padding: 10px 14px; border: 1.5px solid var(--colors-neutral-border, #E1E6E4); border-radius: 8px; font-family: 'DM Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 14px; color: var(--colors-earthy-ink, #242E2A); background: #fff; transition: all 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); outline: none; } .ds-input:focus { border-color: var(--colors-earthy-ink, #242E2A); }

components.css: .ds-stat-card { background: #ffffff; border-radius: 12px; padding: 24px; border: 1px solid var(--colors-neutral-border, #E1E6E4); display: flex; align-items: flex-start; gap: 16px; transition: all 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); font-family: 'DM Sans', sans-serif; } .ds-stat-card:hover { border-color: var(--colors-neutral-border-dark, #CED6D3); box-shadow: 0 4px 12px rgba(36, 46, 42, 0.03); } .ds-stat-icon { width: 48px; height: 48px; border-radius: 8px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; flex-shrink: 0; font-weight: 700; font-size: 24px; } .ds-stat-icon.ds-success { background: #E6EFEA; color: #2A7356; } .ds-stat-content { flex: 1; } .ds-stat-label { font-family: 'Bricolage Grotesque', sans-serif; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; color: #44544F; margin-bottom: 8px; } .ds-stat-value { font-family: 'Bricolage Grotesque', sans-serif; font-size: 32px; font-weight: 700; color: #242E2A; line-height: 1; }

narrative.overview: Calm, authoritative, and highly structured. A digital extension of official paperwork without the clutter. It is efficient, clear, and respects the hierarchy of government workflows. The system translates physical disposition sheets into a precise digital format, replacing ambiguity with strict tracking and grounded aesthetics.
keyCharacteristics: Grounded, official color palette (Forest Green and Harvest Gold).

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: The primary green is reserved for primary actions, active navigation states, and key highlights. It should not be overused as a background.

rules.name: The Bureaucratic Legibility Rule
rules.body: Data tables and form labels must use the label weight (600) to ensure scanability, while input data remains regular weight (400) to distinguish structure from content.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest, defined by a 1px border. Shadows appear only as a response to state (hover, elevation, focus) for a minimalist/editorial feel.

dos: Do use the strict border system to separate content regions.
Do reserve Harvest Gold for items requiring attention or warnings.
donts: Don't use pure black (#000000) for text; stick to Earthy Ink.
Don't apply ambient drop shadows to cards at rest.
